cluster_name.description: Cluster name; used for config file search and client identification.

id.description: ID portion of the client name (e.g., 'mirror' for 'client.mirror')

conf_path.description: Path to the Ceph configuration file

mon_host.description: List of monitor addresses in the form 'host[:port]'. If empty, ceph.conf is used.

keyring_path.description: Absolute path to the client keyring file. Empty means use standard location.

log_file.description: Absolute path to the log file. Empty means use default logging behavior.

debug_cephfs_mirror.description: Debug level string in the form 'debug_level/debug_memory_level' (e.g., '20/20')
